description: Type-check the project with its own tsc (no emit, no browser needed). Returns diagnostics: file (relative to the root), line, column, TypeScript code and message. Run it after editing code; vite doesn't type-check, so the game can run with type errors.

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.

name: typecheck
title: Type-check
